bib.title: Gorilla: Large Language Model Connected with Massive APIs

read.skipped: References skimmed; figure-axis number dumps (Figs 5, 10, 11) not read line by line.

question: Can a fine-tuned LLM select and write correct API calls from a large, overlapping, changing set of ML APIs, and how does retrieval interact with that?
hypothesis: Retriever-aware fine-tuning of LLaMA-7B on API documentation beats prompting GPT-4 on API-call accuracy, cuts hallucination and lets the model adapt to test-time documentation changes.
contributions: APIBench: 1,645 API calls from TorchHub, TensorFlow Hub and HuggingFace with synthetic Self-Instruct instructions
Gorilla, a retrieve-aware fine-tuned LLaMA-7B for API calls
AST sub-tree matching to score functional correctness and to define hallucination
Evidence that the model adapts to test-time API documentation changes and reasons about constraints

method.summary: Scrape model cards from three ML hubs, have GPT-4 write 10 instructions per API via Self-Instruct, fine-tune LLaMA-7B on instruction-API pairs with or without a retrieved API document appended to the prompt, and score outputs by AST sub-tree match against the API database.
method.task: API call generation (single call) from a natural language request

datasets.name: APIBench: Torch Hub
datasets.size: 94 API calls in Sec 1 and Fig 3 (95 in Sec 3.1 and App 8.1)
datasets.preprocessing: model cards converted to JSON with fields domain, framework, functionality, api_name, api_call, api_arguments, environment_requirements, example_code, performance, description

datasets.name: APIBench: TensorFlow Hub
datasets.size: 626 API calls after filtering v2's 801 models (Sec 3.1, Fig 3); 696 in Sec 1 and App 8.1
datasets.source: TensorFlow Hub v2 model cards, filtered for models with little or no card information

datasets.name: APIBench: HuggingFace
datasets.size: 925 models: top 20 per domain from about 203,681 hosted models
datasets.source: HuggingFace Model Hub model cards, top 20 most downloaded per task category
datasets.preprocessing: domains: 7 multimodal, 8 CV, 12 NLP, 5 audio, 2 tabular, 2 RL

datasets.name: Self-Instruct instruction-API pairs
datasets.size: 16,450 pairs (10 per API x 1,645); the Limitations section says over 11,000 instruction-API pairs are released
datasets.split: pairs divided into train and held-out test sets as above
datasets.source: GPT-4 with 3 in-context examples sampled from 6 hand-written per hub (18 hand-written total) plus the API doc; told not to use API names or hints
datasets.preprocessing: converted to one-round user-agent chat conversations

models.name: Gorilla
models.context: inferred: max seq length 2048 in training (Table 4)

training.objective: standard instruction fine-tuning on user-agent chat conversations; retriever-aware variant appends 'Use this API documentation for reference: <retrieved_API_doc_JSON>' to the user prompt

other.retriever_aware_training_doc: the golden-truth (oracle) API document, with the output generated by GPT-4 (Sec 4.1 'Finetuning with Retrieval')

inference.samples: not stated; single output per test item implied, no seeds or repeats reported
inference.prompting: zero-shot: natural language request only, no prompt tuning. With retriever: '<user_prompt> Use this API documentation for reference: <retrieved_API_doc_JSON>'
inference.retrieval: BM25 and GPT-Index (text-davinci-003), each API one document, top-1 retrieved; Oracle returns the ground-truth API doc

other.hf_baseline_scoring: for HuggingFace, all models except Gorilla are only checked on whether they give the correct domain name (a multiple-choice reduction)

metrics.name: AST accuracy (overall)
metrics.definition: generated call parsed to an AST; correct if it is a sub-tree of the reference API, matching only the arguments defined per API (Torch Hub: repo_or_dir, model; TensorFlow Hub: hub.KerasLayer / hub.load with handle; HuggingFace: pretrained_model_name_or_path except for pipeline)

metrics.name: hallu
metrics.definition: API call that is not a sub-tree of any API in the database (an imagined tool)

metrics.name: err
metrics.definition: API invoked incorrectly (a real API but wrong one); distinct from hallucination

eval.protocol: Held-out test split of instruction-API pairs; each model run with 0-shot, BM25, GPT-Index and Oracle retrieval; no seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests reported.

prompts.text: <user_prompt> Use this API documentation for reference: <retrieved_API_doc_JSON>

limits: HuggingFace comparison is not like-for-like: baselines are scored only on domain name, Gorilla on full API match.
Test sets are held-out instruction splits of the same Self-Instruct data used for training, so in-distribution.
Test-time documentation change is shown with two qualitative examples, no measurement.
No seeds, repeats, confidence intervals, decoding settings or optimizer reported.
Only ML model-hub APIs; authors concede this and the bias risk of ML APIs.
Example code in the dataset is not executed; execution is not evaluated.
Dataset counts are inconsistent (94/95 Torch Hub, 626/696 TF Hub; 16,450 vs over 11,000 pairs); Table 2 column headings appear transposed against Table 1.
Closed baselines are 2023 checkpoints (gpt-4-0314, gpt-3.5-turbo-0301, claude-v1).
